instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: The instrument to look up, e.g. 'USD_JPY'. NORMALISED: USDJPY, USD/JPY, usd-jpy and USD_JPY are all one instrument. Aliases: XAUUSD/gold -> XAU_USD, XAGUSD/silver -> XAG_USD, SPX500 -> SPX500_USD, NAS100 -> NAS100_USD.

timeframe.title: Timeframe
timeframe.description: The timeframe to look up, e.g. 'H1'. NORMALISED: 60m == H1, 1h == H1, 4h == H4, 1d == D1.

strategy_type.title: Strategy Type
strategy_type.description: The strategy type, e.g. 'donchian_breakout'. Case and separator insensitive: 'Donchian Breakout' == 'donchian_breakout'.

family.title: Family
family.description: The strategy family, e.g. 'breakout'. Case and separator insensitive.

free_text.title: Free Text
free_text.description: A free-text description, matched on normalised token overlap against the entry's name, type, family and edge_type. Generic words ('strategy', 'backtest', 'using') are stopwords and carry no matching signal.

tools.name: v1_edge_replication
tools.description: Is that track record real, or did you find it by looking? (PAID $3.00)

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: The return series, as a JSON list of numbers. EITHER this or 'returns_csv_b64' is required, never both. At most 200000 observations; a longer series is a 400 naming the limit. NaN and infinity are rejected — they are not a return series.

returns_csv_b64.title: Returns Csv B64
returns_csv_b64.description: The return series as a base64-encoded CSV, one number per row. The alternative to 'returns'. Decoded size is capped at 1 MB.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: 'daily' or 'per_trade'. REQUIRED. A daily series is annualised with sqrt(252); a per_trade series is reported PER TRADE and is never annualised, because a per-trade series has no knowable trades-per-year.

trials_attempted.title: Trials Attempted
trials_attempted.description: How many configurations you tried before keeping this one. REQUIRED, and must be >= 2. This is the number that makes the Deflated Sharpe meaningful: a Sharpe of 2.0 found after 500 tries is priced for what it is. We never assume trials = 1.

claimed.title: Claimed
claimed.description: Optional: {sharpe, cagr, max_dd} — your stated figures. When supplied they are compared against the computed ones and a mismatch is a named finding.

strategy_shape.title: Strategy Shape
strategy_shape.description: Optional: {type, instrument, timeframe}. 'type' is one of trend | mean_reversion | breakout | other and selects the calibration bucket; 'instrument' selects the instrument-class bucket. Instruments are NORMALISED (EUR/USD == EUR_USD == eurusd).

query.title: Query
query.description: Free-text capability match against the observed catalogue (path + summary + declared tags). Empty string = all. Supports a substring match and a token AND-match.

max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd
max_price_usd.description: Price ceiling in USD. An endpoint whose price we have NOT observed is EXCLUDED from a price-filtered query — an unknown price is not a cheap price.

network.title: Network
network.description: CAIP-2 network filter, e.g. 'eip155:8453'. Empty = any.

min_uptime_pct.title: Min Uptime Pct
min_uptime_pct.description: Uptime floor in percent. An endpoint we cannot yet score (fewer than 3 observations) is EXCLUDED — we do not guess.

require_conformance.title: Require Conformance
require_conformance.description: When true, drop every endpoint whose conformance is 'insufficient_observations'.
